answer: At 16 units per epoch, sustaining 375 aliases for 40 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the hostile operator. The fee is charged through a marble debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the sable totals, and the glacier anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 24 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
